lines.beaver_en: Where should we go on this trip?
lines.en: How about Jeju Island? It has a wide sea.
Busan is good too. But it's my first time to Jeju.

lines.beaver: 그럼 제주도로 가요! 여권은 필요 없지요?
lines.beaver_en: Then let's go to Jeju! We don't need passports, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom jejudoro gayo! Yeogwoneun piryo eopjiyo?
lines.en: Right, but I'm a foreigner, so I'll bring mine.

lines.learner: 네, 지난달 대사관에서 새 여권을 받았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I got a new passport at the embassy last month.
lines.roman: Ne, jinandal daesagwaneseo sae yeogwoneul badasseoyo.

lines.en: It's a clean hotel. You can see the sea.
We need warm clothes. It's very windy.

lines.beaver_en: What about shoes? We'll walk a lot.
lines.en: Let's bring comfortable shoes. Mountains are tough.
Sounds good. I really want to see Hallasan too.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. Let's bring just one bag each.
lines.en: Okay, I'll bring a small bag.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we check the list again? All set, right?
lines.en: Yes, all done! Let's have a fun trip!
